# AuraBook

AuraBook is shared memory for AI coding agents.

Canonical site: https://aurabooks.vercel.app/
Backend API: https://aurabook-api.manzilsapkota.workers.dev

## Purpose

AuraBook captures resolved coding failure trajectories, turns them into concise system notes, embeds those notes, and retrieves them before a future agent repeats the same failure loop.

## Useful Pages

- Home: https://aurabooks.vercel.app/
- Installation and privacy: https://aurabooks.vercel.app/quickstart.html
- Live demo: https://aurabooks.vercel.app/demo
- Knowledge dashboard: https://aurabooks.vercel.app/dashboard

The initial four notes are historical demonstration examples, not current adoption metrics. An unavailable API is shown separately from an empty database. The client source currently requires repository access.

## Public API

- GET https://aurabook-api.manzilsapkota.workers.dev/health
- GET https://aurabook-api.manzilsapkota.workers.dev/v1/dashboard/snapshot
- GET https://aurabook-api.manzilsapkota.workers.dev/v1/demo/models/warm?provider=openai
- POST https://aurabook-api.manzilsapkota.workers.dev/v1/demo/models
- POST https://aurabook-api.manzilsapkota.workers.dev/v1/demo/compare

## Private Signed API

These routes require AuraBook HMAC headers when AURABOOK_CLOUD_API_SHARED_SECRET is configured:

- POST /v1/ingest
- POST /v1/search
- POST /v1/prefetch
- POST /v1/feedback
- POST /v1/admin/prune

Required signing headers:

- X-AuraBook-Timestamp
- X-AuraBook-Signature

Optional idempotency header:

- X-AuraBook-Idempotency-Key

## Notes For Agents

If you fetch the site without JavaScript, use this file and the static HTML fallback as the source of truth. The React app provides the interactive browser UI, while the API routes above provide machine-readable data.
